reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the limitation of soft ferromagnetism in prior FeCoNi-based HEAs by proposing a chemically sound substitution (Ir) to enhance magnetocrystalline anisotropy, a mechanism well-grounded in spin-orbit coupling physics. It is specific, testable, and constrained to the required high-entropy regime, whereas Hypothesis B relies on microstructural refinement of the base FeCoNi alloy, which does not meet the equiatomic multicomponent requirement and thus fails to address the research question's constraints.
